integrity: Analytical statement, premises sourced to the original Doob-kernel theorem, standalone exact rational checks supplementing a proof; no independent validation or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the limiting persistence-conditioned kernel only and only to nontrivial expanding parameter regimes. The parameter-only convergence bounds are not claimed sharp. Finite-grid checks are not a proof of the continuum result.
title: A sharp mixing-index phase diagram for persistence-conditioned uniform moving averages
